_readme: Who this copy of the app belongs to. The resume, cover-letter and application-answer prompts read every personal detail from here. TEMPLATE: every value below is a placeholder that ONBOARDING.md replaces. name: full name, also the cover-letter signature. first_name: used in prompts like "Sell Alex honestly". pronouns: subject/object/possessive (e.g. she/her/her), used wherever the prompts refer to the owner in the third person. current_title: the title the resume headline must begin with. city, state, home_base: where the owner lives; home_base is the full phrase used in prompts. hybrid_areas: nearby metro areas the owner would take hybrid roles in, written as they should appear in the prompt (e.g. "Austin/San Antonio"). resume_library: the file holding the approved resume bullets. tailor_rules: the file holding owner-specific tailoring rules (employer names, topic tags, salary hint); optional, an empty file is fine. sources: documents given to the model as facts, in order; each needs a label (shown to the model) and a path relative to the repo root. Keep style guide and resume library in the list; add the owner's own career documents after them.
